description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components that output log information and can be linked in a chain for complex logging behavior.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node capable of outputting log messages and being linked with other nodes for chain-based logging.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable, to be implemented by classes realizing this interface.
